title: ゲーム制作演習
subtitle: Video-Game Production
keywords: Unity 2.Setting the production environment 3.Game production process 4.Game programming
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn the basics of game production using Unity. More specifically, they will build a development environment on their individual PCs and learn the game production process through 2D and 3D sample programs. By applying original ideas such as game design, images and animation expressions, and program functions, students will be able to acquire the application skills needed to expand into original game creation.
advice: In this course, students will learn to understand the configuration and operation of the game sample program used by checking the game operations and rules described in each chapter in the textbook. Based on this sample program, students will then try various ideas and work to create original games. In this class, the Unity game engine is used. In addition, since C# is used for the script that controls the game, an object-oriented language review is essential for all students.
requiredKnowledge: Experience in programming with object-oriented languages and a good understanding of programming basics is required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to build a game in the Unity production development environment.
Be able to understand the game production process.
Be able to create multiple basic games.
Be able to extend a game with originality by adding original stories, images, and animations to the basic game.
